name: Implement Valkey Stream consumer groups for agent work queues
description: Create stream entries for every mission, packet submission, disclosure approval, gate check, and PR generation. Implement XGROUP CREATE for consumer groups. XPENDING for stuck worker detection. XCLAIM for abandoned work reassignment. XACK for completion signaling. XRANGE for replay/debugging. This task is scoped to Valkey stream primitives and consumer group mechanics only — it does NOT claim end-to-end work queue correctness, which requires the durable ACK binding tasks.
